prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE production web hero BACKGROUND image, 1920x1100 landscape, pure artwork only with NO TEXT OR UI. The attached web mockup is ONLY a reference for its computational terrain artwork, not its layout, typography or interface. This is for an algorithm research studio and must be more precise and technology-forward than the reference's silver real-estate miniature.

SCENE: A deep near-black / midnight ink seamless environment. A large, beautifully constructed geospatial point-cloud dataset emerges across the RIGHT half and LOWER third of the frame, with long three-dimensional spatial depth. Hundreds of thousands of tiny pin-sharp cool-white and ice-cyan sampling points form a coherent urban district, street grids, a winding river and subtle undulating terrain. The RIGHTmost area has a few restrained crisp geometric building outlines, fine triangulated surface meshes and small partially solid pale surfaces, showing data being reconstructed. Most of the scene remains actual individual point-cloud samples and wireframe contours. The light is reflected physical rendering, not heavy glow. Use subtle depth of field only at the far background, keeping the principal data field sharp. Cool white is dominant; ice-cyan is a restrained secondary. No purple or magenta anywhere. No gold.

COMPOSITION: Entire upper-left 45% must be almost uniformly dark (#070c12 to #0a111b) quiet negative space for live HTML copy. Upper center also stays quiet. Data occupies right half and lower 35%, with a sweeping diagonal perspective leading from lower-left foreground points toward a taller reconstructed cluster at right. Leave enough density to impress, but the left headline zone must remain dark and readable. Let the point cloud feather naturally into black at its boundaries. No horizon seam, no frame or screenshot shape. Main object is not a mountain sculpture or a shiny city diorama; it is a high-resolution scientific spatial reconstruction.

MOOD: understated premium computational engineering, captivating depth, precise clean geometry, cinematic but credible. No giant orb, neural-network ball, abstract liquid blob, giant chips, circuit boards, logos, numbers, graphs, code, dashboard overlays, floating panels, labels, lasers or data HUD. Absolutely no text, words or watermark. One coherent view, not a collage or triptych.
note: Brand visual concept; not measured geospatial algorithm evidence.
